```{r parametros-y-helpers, include=FALSE}
## ==========================================================

find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  cur <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(cur, "config_ipom.m")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(cur, "src", "r"))) {
      return(cur)
    }
    parent <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(parent, cur)) {
      stop("No pude encontrar la raíz del proyecto. Abre R/RStudio desde la carpeta del proyecto o usa run_update_data_from_r.R.")
    }
    cur <- parent
  }
}

## ==========================================================
## 1. Helpers de descarga y transformación
## ==========================================================

bde_get_series <- function(user, pass, series_id,
                           first_date = "1996-01-01",
                           last_date  = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  base_url <- "https://si3.bcentral.cl/SieteRestWS/SieteRestWS.ashx"

  ## Importante:
  ## 1) No armamos la URL con paste0, porque usuarios/passwords pueden tener
  ##    caracteres especiales que deben ir URL-encoded.
  ## 2) No usamos rjson::fromJSON(file = url), porque en Windows/BDE puede fallar
  ##    con respuestas Latin-1 o bytes no UTF-8 válidos.
  res <- httr::GET(
    base_url,
    query = list(
      user       = user,
      pass       = pass,
      timeseries = series_id,
      firstdate  = first_date,
      lastdate   = last_date,
      `function` = "GetSeries"
    ),
    httr::timeout(60)
  )

  if (httr::http_error(res)) {
    stop(
      "Error HTTP al descargar BDE ", series_id, ": ",
      httr::status_code(res), " ", httr::http_status(res)$message
    )
  }

  raw_txt <- httr::content(res, as = "raw")
  txt <- rawToChar(raw_txt)

  ## Normalización robusta de encoding: primero UTF-8, luego Latin-1.
  txt_utf8 <- iconv(txt, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  if (is.na(txt_utf8) || !nzchar(txt_utf8)) {
    txt_utf8 <- iconv(txt, from = "latin1", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  }
  if (is.na(txt_utf8) || !nzchar(txt_utf8)) {
    stop("Respuesta BDE vacía o con encoding ilegible para la serie ", series_id)
  }

  ## Si BDE devuelve HTML/texto de error en vez de JSON, esto ayuda a diagnosticar.
  first_char <- substr(trimws(txt_utf8), 1, 1)
  if (!first_char %in% c("{", "[")) {
    stop(
      "BDE no devolvió JSON para la serie ", series_id, ". Primeros caracteres: ",
      substr(trimws(txt_utf8), 1, 300)
    )
  }

  json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt_utf8, simplifyVector = FALSE)

  if (is.null(json_data$Series$Obs) || length(json_data$Series$Obs) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  obs_list <- json_data$Series$Obs

  df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(obs_list, function(x) {
      data.frame(
        indexDateString = as.character(x$indexDateString),
        value           = as.character(x$value),
        statusCode      = as.character(x$statusCode),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  )

  names(df) <- c("date_str", "value", "status")
  df$date <- as.Date(as.character(df$date_str), format = "%d-%m-%Y")

  suppressWarnings({
    df$value_num <- as.numeric(df$value)
  })

  df
}

fred_get_series <- function(api_key, series_id,
                            start_date = "1996-01-01",
                            end_date   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"

  res <- httr::GET(url, query = list(
    series_id         = series_id,
    api_key           = api_key,
    file_type         = "json",
    observation_start = start_date,
    observation_end   = end_date
  ))

  httr::stop_for_status(res)

  json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  df <- json_data$observations

  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  df$date <- as.Date(df$date)

  suppressWarnings({
    df$value_num <- as.numeric(df$value)
  })

  df
}

to_quarterly <- function(df, varname,
                         date_col = "date",
                         value_col = "value_num",
                         fun = mean) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(data.frame(qdate = as.yearqtr(character())))

  df %>%
    select(all_of(c(date_col, value_col))) %>%
    rename(date = !!date_col, value = !!value_col) %>%
    mutate(qdate = as.yearqtr(date)) %>%
    group_by(qdate) %>%
    summarise(
      !!varname := fun(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

hp_onesided <- function(x, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))

  valid <- which(!is.na(x))
  if (length(valid) < min_obs) return(out)

  x_valid <- x[valid]

  for (i in seq_along(x_valid)) {
    if (i >= min_obs) {
      hp_i <- mFilter::hpfilter(x_valid[1:i], freq = lambda)
      out[valid[i]] <- as.numeric(tail(hp_i$trend, 1))
    }
  }

  out
}

fill_log_from_yoy <- function(log_var, yoy_perc, qdate_vec) {
  out <- log_var

  for (i in seq_along(out)) {
    if (is.na(out[i]) && !is.na(yoy_perc[i])) {
      prev_qdate <- qdate_vec[i] - 1
      j <- which(qdate_vec == prev_qdate)

      if (length(j) == 1 && !is.na(out[j])) {
        d4_log <- 100 * log(1 + yoy_perc[i] / 100)
        out[i] <- out[j] + d4_log
      }
    }
  }

  out
}

make_matlab_vec <- function(db, var, name, q_from, q_to, digits = 12) {
  sub <- db %>%
    filter(qdate >= q_from, qdate <= q_to) %>%
    arrange(qdate)

  vals <- sub[[var]]

  txt <- paste0(
    name, "(startfcast:startfcast+", length(vals) - 1, ") = [",
    paste0(round(vals, digits), collapse = ", "),
    "];"
  )

  txt
}

fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f"))
}

stars_p <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < 0.01 ~ "***",
    p < 0.05 ~ "**",
    p < 0.10 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

tidy_systemfit_eq <- function(modelo, eq_prefix = "eq1_", digits = 3) {
  b  <- coef(modelo)
  vc <- vcov(modelo)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vc))

  tibble(
    term      = names(b),
    estimate  = as.numeric(b),
    std.error = as.numeric(se)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      statistic = estimate / std.error,
      p.value   = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE),
      term      = gsub(paste0("^", eq_prefix), "", term),
      stars     = stars_p(p.value),
      estimate_fmt = paste0(fmt_num(estimate, digits), stars),
      se_fmt       = paste0("(", fmt_num(std.error, digits), ")")
    )
}

make_systemfit_kable <- function(modelo, caption = "", eq_prefix = "eq1_", coef_labels = NULL) {
  tab <- tidy_systemfit_eq(modelo, eq_prefix = eq_prefix)

  if (!is.null(coef_labels)) {
    tab <- tab %>%
      mutate(term = dplyr::recode(term, !!!coef_labels, .default = term))
  }

  tab_out <- tab %>%
    transmute(
      Variable = term,
      Coeficiente = estimate_fmt,
      `Error estándar` = se_fmt,
      `t/z` = fmt_num(statistic, 3),
      `p-value` = fmt_num(p.value, 3)
    )

  knitr::kable(
    tab_out,
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = caption,
    align = "lcccc",
    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
      font_size = 9
    )
}
```

```{r descarga-y-base, include=FALSE}
bde_q <- lapply(series_bde, function(s) {
  raw <- bde_get_series(
    user = bde_user,
    pass = bde_pass,
    series_id = s$code,
    first_date = start_date,
    last_date = end_date
  )

  to_quarterly(raw, s$var)
})

db_trimestral <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "qdate"),
  lista_q
) %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    date_q  = as.Date(qdate),
    year    = year(date_q),
    quarter = quarter(date_q)
  ) %>%
  select(qdate, year, quarter, date_q, everything())

i_last <- nrow(db_trimestral) - 1

if (i_last > 0 && is.na(db_trimestral$pib_no_minero[i_last])) {
  db_trimestral$pib_no_minero[i_last] <- 50878.65069
}

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    tpm = case_when(
      qdate <= as.yearqtr("2001 Q2") ~ tpm + 3,
      qdate == as.yearqtr("2001 Q3") ~ 6.5,
      TRUE ~ tpm
    ),
    lpib_no_minero = if_else(!is.na(pib_no_minero) & pib_no_minero > 0, log(pib_no_minero) * 100, NA_real_),
    lipc           = if_else(!is.na(ipc) & ipc > 0, log(ipc) * 100, NA_real_),
    lipc_sin_vol   = if_else(!is.na(ipc_sin_vol) & ipc_sin_vol > 0, log(ipc_sin_vol) * 100, NA_real_),
    ltcr           = if_else(!is.na(tcr) & tcr > 0, log(tcr) * 100, NA_real_),
    lcpi_us        = if_else(!is.na(cpi_us) & cpi_us > 0, log(cpi_us) * 100, NA_real_)
  )
```

```{r brecha-y-precios, include=FALSE}
  "2020Q1" = -2.961179307194357, "2020Q2" = -15.644322721802661,
  "2020Q3" = -11.209283594069989, "2020Q4" = -3.743220983959708
)

gap_ipom_df <- tibble(
  q_key = names(gap_ipom),
  gap_ipom_aux = as.numeric(gap_ipom)
)

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    q_key = paste0(format(qdate, "%Y"), "Q", format(qdate, "%q"))
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(
    "gap_ipom_aux", "pib_pot_hp_fallback", "gap_hp_fallback",
    "gap_pib_bcch", "pib_pot_bcch", "pib_pot_bcch_nivel",
    "gap_pib_ipom", "pib_pot_ipom"
  )))

db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback <- NA_real_
db_trimestral$gap_hp_fallback <- NA_real_

idx_hp <- which(
  db_trimestral$qdate <= as.yearqtr("2020 Q4") &
    !is.na(db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero)
)

if (length(idx_hp) >= 20) {
  hp_aux <- hp_onesided(
    db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_hp],
    lambda = 1600,
    min_obs = 20
  )

  db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback[idx_hp] <- hp_aux
  db_trimestral$gap_hp_fallback[idx_hp] <-
    db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_hp] -
    db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback[idx_hp]
}

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  left_join(gap_ipom_df, by = "q_key") %>%
  mutate(
    gap_pib_bcch = case_when(
      ## Usar brecha fijada/legacy cuando existe. Esto cubre 2000Q1-2020Q4.
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2000 Q1") &
        qdate <= as.yearqtr("2020 Q4") &
        !is.na(gap_ipom_aux) ~ gap_ipom_aux,

      ## Fallback solo si algún punto 2000-2004 no quedó definido en gap_ipom.
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2000 Q1") &
        qdate <= as.yearqtr("2004 Q4") &
        is.na(gap_ipom_aux) ~ gap_hp_fallback,

      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2021 Q1") &
        !is.na(gap_exog) ~ gap_exog,

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    pib_pot_bcch = if_else(
      !is.na(lpib_no_minero) & !is.na(gap_pib_bcch),
      lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_bcch,
      NA_real_
    ),
    pib_pot_bcch_nivel = if_else(!is.na(pib_pot_bcch), exp(pib_pot_bcch / 100), NA_real_),
    gap_pib_ipom = gap_pib_bcch,
    pib_pot_ipom = pib_pot_bcch
  )

cpi_us_ref <- db_trimestral %>%
  filter(qdate == as.yearqtr("2020 Q1")) %>%
  pull(cpi_us)

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    cobre_real = if_else(
      !is.na(cobre) & !is.na(cpi_us) & cobre > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      cobre * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    petroleo_real = if_else(
      !is.na(petroleo) & !is.na(cpi_us) & petroleo > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      petroleo * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    lcobre_real = if_else(!is.na(cobre_real) & cobre_real > 0, log(cobre_real) * 100, NA_real_),
    lpetroleo_real = if_else(!is.na(petroleo_real) & petroleo_real > 0, log(petroleo_real) * 100, NA_real_),
    energiav12 = if_else(!is.na(energia), (log(energia) - lag(log(energia), 4)) * 100, NA_real_)
  )
```

```{r socios-neutral, include=FALSE}
crec_socios_q <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("qdate", "year")),
  list(crec_bra_q, crec_chn_q, crec_usa_q, crec_jpn_q, crec_eur_q)
)

if (file.exists(file_path_pond)) {
  Ponderadores <- readxl::read_excel(
    file_path_pond,
    sheet = "NuevosPonderadores",
    skip = 1,
    col_names = TRUE,
    range = readxl::cell_limits(c(1, 1), c(NA, 6))
  ) %>%
    rename(year = fecha) %>%
    mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
    rename(
      Brasil_w = Brasil,
      China_w  = China,
      EEUU_w   = `Estados Unidos`,
      Japon_w  = Japón,
      Euro_w   = `Zona Euro`
    )

  crec_socios_q <- crec_socios_q %>%
    left_join(Ponderadores, by = "year") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      crec_socios = sum(
        Brasil_g * Brasil_w,
        China_g  * China_w,
        EEUU_g   * EEUU_w,
        Japon_g  * Japon_w,
        Euro_g   * Euro_w,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
        sum(c(Brasil_w, China_w, EEUU_w, Japon_w, Euro_w), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(qdate, crec_socios)
} else {
  crec_socios_q <- crec_socios_q %>%
    mutate(crec_socios = rowMeans(select(., ends_with("_g")), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    select(qdate, crec_socios)
}

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
```

```{r pseudo-ipom-y-variables, include=FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## 5. Muestra aumentada con pseudo-observaciones IPoM
## ==========================================================

w_hist <- 1.0
w_ipom <- 0.50

q_start_fcast  <- as.yearqtr("2026 Q1")
horiz_quarters <- 9L
q_fcast        <- seq(q_start_fcast, by = 0.25, length.out = horiz_quarters)

gdp_yoy_ipom <- c(
  0.9933, 1.9491, 2.3467, 2.2434, 2.5342,

proy_inputs <- tibble(
  qdate              = q_fcast,

  petroleo_nom_fcast   = c(82.5, 88.6, 87.5, 85.6, 78.0, 75.2, 73.3, 72.4, 71.9),

  alimentos_fcast   = c(127.8000, 127.7600, 127.4433, 125.4000, 120.7267, 118.1767, 117.2633, 117.0333, 117.7600),
  energia_fcast     = c(-0.499, 14.963, 12.230, 11.790, 9.864, -3.155, -2.249, 0.951, 3.052),

  ffr_fcast          = c(3.6, 3.6, 3.6, 3.6, 3.4, 3.4, 3.4, 3.4, 3.1),
  ltcr_fcast         = ltcr_fcast,
  vix_fcast          = c(24, 22, 21, 19, 18.5, 18, 17.25, 17, 17),
  us10y_fcast        = c(4.25, 4.50, 4.55, 4.65, 4.63, 4.55, 4.37, 4.20, 4.00),
  tasa_neutral_fcast = c(4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4),

  crec_socios_fcast  = c(2.7, 2.7, 2.7, 2.7, 2.9, 2.9, 2.9, 2.9, 2.9),

  eee_ipcsv12_fcast  = eee_ipcsv12_fcast
)

stopifnot(nrow(proy_inputs) == horiz_quarters)

db_hist <- db_trimestral %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  select(
    qdate, year, quarter,
    pib_no_minero, lpib_no_minero,
    pib_pot_bcch, gap_pib_bcch,
    ipc, lipc,
    ipc_sin_vol, lipc_sin_vol,
    cpi_us,
    cobre, lcobre_real,
    petroleo, lpetroleo_real, alimentos, energiav12,
    tcr, ltcr,
    tpm, tasa_neutral, tasa_coloc,
    crec_socios, ffr, us10y, vix,
    eee_ipc12, eee_ipcsv12
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = "hist",
    w = w_hist
  )

db_model <- db_hist %>%
  full_join(proy_inputs, by = "qdate") %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    year    = year(as.Date(qdate)),
    quarter = quarter(as.Date(qdate)),
    sample  = if_else(qdate < q_start_fcast, "hist", "ipom"),
    w       = if_else(sample == "hist", w_hist, w_ipom)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year         = if_else(sample == "ipom", year_fcast, year),

    ltcr         = if_else(sample == "ipom", ltcr_fcast, ltcr),
    tcr          = if_else(sample == "ipom", exp(ltcr / 100), tcr),

    cobre        = if_else(sample == "ipom", cobre_nom_fcast, cobre),
    lcobre_real  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lcobre_real_fcast, lcobre_real),

    petroleo        = if_else(sample == "ipom", petroleo_nom_fcast, petroleo),
    lpetroleo_real  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lpetroleo_real_fcast, lpetroleo_real),

    alimentos = if_else(sample == "ipom", alimentos_fcast, alimentos),
    energia = if_else(sample == "ipom", energia_fcast, energiav12),

    ffr          = if_else(sample == "ipom", ffr_fcast, ffr),
    us10y        = if_else(sample == "ipom", us10y_fcast, us10y),
    vix          = if_else(sample == "ipom", vix_fcast, vix),
    tasa_neutral = if_else(sample == "ipom", tasa_neutral_fcast, tasa_neutral),
    tasa_coloc   = if_else(sample == "ipom", tasa_coloc_fcast, tasa_coloc),
    tpm          = if_else(sample == "ipom", tpm_fcast, tpm),

    crec_socios  = if_else(sample == "ipom", crec_socios_fcast, crec_socios),
    eee_ipc12    = if_else(sample == "ipom", eee_ipc12_fcast, eee_ipc12),
    eee_ipcsv12  = if_else(sample == "ipom", eee_ipcsv12_fcast, eee_ipcsv12)
  )

last_hist_cpi_idx <- max(which(!is.na(db_model$cpi_us) & db_model$qdate < q_start_fcast))
g_us_annual  <- 0.02
g_us_quarter <- (1 + g_us_annual)^(1/4) - 1

if (last_hist_cpi_idx < nrow(db_model)) {
  for (i in (last_hist_cpi_idx + 1):nrow(db_model)) {
    if (is.na(db_model$cpi_us[i])) {
      db_model$cpi_us[i] <- db_model$cpi_us[i - 1] * (1 + g_us_quarter)
    }
  }
}

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    lipc = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lipc),
    lipc_sin_vol = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lipc_sin_vol)
  )

db_model$lipc <- fill_log_from_yoy(
  db_model$lipc,
  db_model$cpi_yoy_fcast,
  db_model$qdate
)

db_model$lipc_sin_vol <- fill_log_from_yoy(
  db_model$lipc_sin_vol,
  db_model$cpixfe_yoy_fcast,
  db_model$qdate
)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    ipc = exp(lipc / 100),
    ipc_sin_vol = exp(lipc_sin_vol / 100),
    lpib_no_minero = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lpib_no_minero)
  )

for (i in seq_along(db_model$qdate)) {
  if (!is.na(db_model$gdp_yoy_fcast[i]) && db_model$qdate[i] >= q_start_fcast) {
    prev_qdate <- db_model$qdate[i] - 1
    j_prev <- which(db_model$qdate == prev_qdate)

    if (length(j_prev) == 1 && !is.na(db_model$lpib_no_minero[j_prev])) {
      d4_log <- 100 * log(1 + db_model$gdp_yoy_fcast[i] / 100)
      db_model$lpib_no_minero[i] <- db_model$lpib_no_minero[j_prev] + d4_log
    }
  }
}

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    pib_no_minero = exp(lpib_no_minero / 100),
    gap_pib_bcch  = if_else(sample == "ipom", gap_pib_tgt_fcast, gap_pib_bcch),
    pib_pot_bcch  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_bcch, pib_pot_bcch)
  )

ss_TPMN1  <- 4.0
ss_L_Z    <- 100 * log(100)
ss_CRECSC <- 3.0
ss_T_COLOC <- 4.0
ss_FFR    <- 3.5
ss_VIX    <- 17
ss_UST10  <- 4.0
ss_L_PCU  <- 100 * log(3.4)
ss_L_WTI  <- 100 * log(59)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    GAP       = gap_pib_bcch,
    GAP_lag1  = dplyr::lag(GAP, 1),

    TPM       = tpm,
    TPM_lag1  = dplyr::lag(TPM, 1),
    TPMN1     = tasa_neutral,

    TPM_dev   = tpm - ss_TPMN1,
    TPM_dev_N = tpm - tasa_neutral,

    CRECSC    = crec_socios,
    FFR       = ffr,
    VIX       = vix,
    UST10     = us10y,

    L_PCU     = lcobre_real,
    L_WTI     = lpetroleo_real,
    T_COLOC   = tasa_coloc,

    Log_Food = log(alimentos),
    L_Food   = 100 * (Log_Food - lag(Log_Food, 4)),

    CRECSC_dev = CRECSC - ss_CRECSC,
    FFR_dev    = FFR - ss_FFR,
    VIX_dev    = VIX - ss_VIX,
    UST10_dev  = UST10 - ss_UST10,
    L_PCU_dev  = L_PCU - ss_L_PCU,
    L_WTI_dev  = L_WTI - ss_L_WTI,
    T_COLOC_dev = T_COLOC - ss_T_COLOC,
    L_Z_dev    = ltcr - ss_L_Z,

    dummy_19Q4 = if_else(year == 2019 & quarter == 4, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q2 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 2, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q3 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 3, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q4 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 4, 1, 0),
    dummy_08Q3 = if_else(year == 2008 & quarter == 3, 1, 0),
    dummy_98Q3 = if_else(year == 1998 & quarter == 3, 1, 0),
    dummy_2008Q1_2008Q4 = if_else(year == 2008 & quarter >= 1 & quarter <= 4, 1, 0),

    DLA_CPIXFE      = 4 * (lipc_sin_vol - dplyr::lag(lipc_sin_vol, 1)),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIXFE, 1),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag4 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIXFE, 4),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lead1 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPIXFE, 1),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lead4 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPIXFE, 4),

    D4L_CPI       = lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 4),
    D1L_CPI       = lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 1),
    DLA_CPI       = 4 * (lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 1)),
    DLA_CPI_lag1  = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPI, 1),
    DLA_CPI_lead1 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPI, 1),
    lead_D4L_CPI  = dplyr::lead(D4L_CPI, 1),
    lead_D4_4L_CPI = dplyr::lead(D4L_CPI, 4),
    lead_D1L_CPI  = dplyr::lead(D1L_CPI, 1),
    lag_D4L_CPI   = dplyr::lag(D4L_CPI, 1),
    lag_D4L_CPI_4 = dplyr::lag(D4L_CPI, 4),

    L_GDP_GAP      = gap_pib_bcch,
    L_GDP_GAP_lag1 = dplyr::lag(L_GDP_GAP, 1),

    Trimestre = factor(quarter),
    dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1 = if_else(
      (year == 2021 & quarter == 4) |
        year == 2022 |
        (year == 2023 & quarter == 1),
      1, 0
    )
  )

db_model$hp_ltcr <- hp_onesided(db_model$ltcr, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    L_Z_GAP     = ltcr - ss_L_Z,
    lag_L_Z_GAP = dplyr::lag(L_Z_GAP, 1),
    L_Z_GAP_Hp     = ltcr - hp_ltcr,
    L_Z_GAP_Hp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp, 1),
    DLA_CPIRES      = D1L_CPI - DLA_CPIXFE,
    DLA_CPIRES_lag1 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIRES, 1)
  )
```

```{r helpers-fitted-vs-observado, include=FALSE}
## ==========================================================
## 7. Helpers fitted vs observado
##    Gráficos limpios: 2018Q1–2027Q4
## ==========================================================

plot_start <- as.yearqtr("2018 Q1")
plot_end   <- as.yearqtr("2027 Q4")
plot_fcast <- as.yearqtr("2026 Q1")

predict_lm_full <- function(modelo, data_full) {
  pred <- tryCatch(
    {
      as.numeric(predict(modelo, newdata = data_full, na.action = na.pass))
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning("predict_lm_full falló: ", conditionMessage(e))
      rep(NA_real_, nrow(data_full))
    }
  )

  if (length(pred) != nrow(data_full)) {
    pred2 <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data_full))
    ncopy <- min(length(pred), nrow(data_full))
    pred2[seq_len(ncopy)] <- pred[seq_len(ncopy)]
    pred <- pred2
  }

  pred
}

predict_systemfit_eq_full <- function(modelo, eq_formula, data_full, eq_prefix = "eq1_") {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(data_full))

  tt <- delete.response(terms(eq_formula))

  X <- tryCatch(
    model.matrix(tt, data = data_full, na.action = na.pass),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(X)) return(out)

  b <- coef(modelo)
  names_b_clean <- sub(paste0("^", eq_prefix), "", names(b))

  b_clean <- as.numeric(b)
  names(b_clean) <- names_b_clean

  common <- intersect(colnames(X), names(b_clean))

  if (length(common) == 0) return(out)

  X_use <- X[, common, drop = FALSE]
  b_use <- b_clean[common]

  ok <- complete.cases(X_use)

  out[ok] <- as.numeric(X_use[ok, , drop = FALSE] %*% b_use)

  out
}

make_fit_df <- function(data_full, yvar, fitted_vec, nombre_modelo) {
  data_full %>%
    transmute(
      qdate = qdate,
      date_q = as.Date(qdate),
      observado = .data[[yvar]],
      fitted = fitted_vec,
      modelo = nombre_modelo,
      sample = if ("sample" %in% names(data_full)) sample else NA_character_
    )
}

prep_fit_plot_data <- function(df,
                               start_q = plot_start,
                               end_q = plot_end) {
  df %>%
    filter(
      qdate >= start_q,
      qdate <= end_q
    ) %>%
    arrange(qdate) %>%
    mutate(
      serie_periodo = case_when(
        qdate < plot_fcast ~ "Histórico",
        qdate >= plot_fcast ~ "Proyección IPoM",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
}

fit_stats <- function(df) {
  df_complete <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(observado), !is.na(fitted))

  n_complete <- nrow(df_complete)

  rmse <- if (n_complete > 0) {
    sqrt(mean((df_complete$observado - df_complete$fitted)^2))
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  mae <- if (n_complete > 0) {
    mean(abs(df_complete$observado - df_complete$fitted))
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  r2 <- if (n_complete >= 2) {
    suppressWarnings(cor(df_complete$observado, df_complete$fitted)^2)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    n = n_complete,
    rmse = rmse,
    mae = mae,
    r2 = r2
  )
}

theme_fit_ipom <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 2),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 1, colour = "grey30"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = base_size - 2, colour = "grey40", hjust = 0),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey88"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.30, colour = "grey86"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

plot_fit_vs_obs_bonito <- function(df,
                                   titulo,
                                   subtitulo = NULL,
                                   ylab = "",
                                   start_q = plot_start,
                                   end_q = plot_end,
                                   fcast_q = plot_fcast,
                                   zero_line = TRUE) {

  df_plot <- prep_fit_plot_data(df, start_q, end_q)

  stats <- fit_stats(df_plot)

  subtitle_txt <- if (is.null(subtitulo)) {
    paste0(
      "Rango: 2018Q1–2027Q4 | RMSE = ",
      ifelse(is.na(stats$rmse), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", stats$rmse)),
      " | MAE = ",
      ifelse(is.na(stats$mae), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", stats$mae)),
      " | R² = ",
      ifelse(is.na(stats$r2), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", stats$r2))
    )
  } else {
    subtitulo
  }

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = date_q)) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = as.Date(fcast_q),
      xmax = as.Date(end_q) + 80,
      ymin = -Inf,
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = "#F2E7D5",
      alpha = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = as.Date(fcast_q),
      linewidth = 0.35,
      colour = "grey45",
      linetype = "dotted"
    )

  if (zero_line) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linewidth = 0.35,
        colour = "grey55"
      )
  }

  p +
    geom_line(
      aes(y = observado, colour = "Observado"),
      linewidth = 1.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(y = fitted, colour = "Fitted"),
      linewidth = 0.95,
      linetype = "longdash",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(y = observado, colour = "Observado"),
      size = 1.15,
      alpha = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "Observado" = "#0B2239",
        "Fitted"    = "#C45A3A"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(as.Date(start_q), as.Date(end_q) + 80),
      date_breaks = "1 year",
      date_labels = "%Y",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = titulo,
      subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      caption = "Área sombreada: pseudo-muestra IPoM / proyección.",
      x = NULL,
      y = ylab,
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    theme_fit_ipom()
}
```
